description: This Java class `PolicyEnforcerCacheLoader` is responsible for asynchronously loading policy enforcers from a shard-region-proxy actor using a cache loader interface. It communicates with an Akka actor system, handles responses related to policies, and transforms responses into cache entries.

classes.name: PolicyEnforcerCacheLoader
classes.description: Provides an asynchronous cache loading mechanism for policy enforcers, communicating with an actor system to retrieve policies.

methods.name: PolicyEnforcerCacheLoader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache loader with an actor proxy and timeout, setting up command creation and response transformation logic.

methods.name: asyncLoad
methods.description: Asynchronously loads a cache entry for a given entity-resource key using delegated actor-ask cache loader.

methods.name: handleSudoRetrievePolicyResponse
methods.description: Processes responses from the policy retrieval actor, converting successful responses into cache entries or handling exceptions.

methods.name: badPolicyResponse
methods.description: Creates a supplier for an IllegalStateException indicating a bad policy response.
